positions.note: hosted: the originator library runs inside the real harness's extension mechanism; lands only if the extension-mechanism timebox succeeds (DESIGN.md 8)
co-resident: the driver runs as a second process in the harness's compose service while the real harness replays with the design's controls active
standalone: driver alone, for the T0 reference row and the T7 observation row

notes: Reduced form of the harness adapter contract (DESIGN.md 3): describe/inject plus dispatch records only (the driver emits dispatch-record/1 per tool-call attempt and injects the io.inspection carriers on the tool-call transports). Supported designs are the fixtures that exist: compose/t0-mock.yaml, t1-mock.yaml, t2-mock.yaml (mode R, standalone driver in its own compose service; the T0 reference row and the gateway/egress designs' exposure cells). The mock harness is a path-originator fixture on the workload side, never an evaluated component and never a row or column of the grid; it hosts no enforcement points. No host mode: there is no OpenClaw-style host placement in v1 (DESIGN.md 8 v1 exclusions; the harness-spawned-server revisit stays a recorded limitation).
